focal_blueprints.title_zh: 双图关联与互补/因果印证段（Synthesizing Dual Charts）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写双图题（如一张图是算力投入/研发经费变化，另一张图是模型误差/碳排放强度变化）的综合关联段，阐明两张图之间的内在协同或背离关系。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 双图组合题 / 论文多指标联合分析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [双图联动锚定 Cross-Chart Link]：Synthesizing both charts reveals a clear inverse / positive relationship between [Chart 1 Variable] and [Chart 2 Variable] up to [Threshold Point].
S2 [区间 1 协同变化 Phase 1 Co-movement]：Specifically, as [Variable X in Chart 1] expanded from [A] to [B] during [Period 1], [Variable Y in Chart 2] dropped correspondingly by [C%].

S3 [区间 2 边际递减/背离 Diminishing Returns / Divergence]：However, beyond [Threshold Point], although [Variable X] continued to double, [Variable Y] plateaued around [Value], indicating diminishing marginal returns.
S4 [例外个体点拨 Exception Highlight]：An exception to this pattern is [Entity Z], which achieved the lowest [Variable Y] despite maintaining moderate [Variable X].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Global Correlation -> Co-movement Phase -> Diminishing Returns / Divergence -> Notable Outlier. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Chart 1 shows R&D spending and Chart 2 shows defect rates. When R&D spending goes up, defect rates go down. Country Z spends little money but has low defect rates.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 极其简陋，未能刻画“初期强相关 -> 超过阈值后边际收益递减 -> 特例分析”的层次感。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Cross-referencing both figures reveals a strong inverse relationship between automated inspection investment and manufacturing defect rates up to a $40 million threshold. Specifically, across plants investing between $10 million and $40 million (Figure 1), surface defect incidence dropped steeply from 4.8% to 0.9% (Figure 2). Beyond $40 million, however, further capital expenditure yielded diminishing returns: doubling investment to $80 million reduced defects by only an additional 0.1 percentage points. Notably, Plant D defied this expenditure curve, achieving a 0.7% defect rate with just $22 million through closed-loop sensor calibration.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 议论文收尾段：跳出简单重复，完成核心权衡整合与边界升华（Synthesis Conclusion）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 结尾段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [重申核心权衡与立场 Restate Nuanced Thesis]：In conclusion, while [Acknowledged Factor A] introduces real challenges in [Specific Aspect], [Core Thesis Stance] remains the most viable path forward.
S2 [整合全文两大支柱机制 Synthesize Dual Pillars]：By combining [Pillar 1 from Body 1] with [Pillar 2 / Safeguard from Body 2], [Actors] can harness [Core Benefit] while containing [Primary Risk].
S3 [理性边界展望（可选）Grounded Forward Look]：Ultimately, the success of [Technology/Policy] depends not on its standalone capability, but on the institutional rigor with which it is governed.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Balanced Restatment -> Dual-Pillar Synthesis -> Grounded Governance Principle (Zero Slogans!). 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. We should make full use of its advantages and avoid its disadvantages. Let us work hand in hand to welcome a bright future of AI!
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 结尾段最忌讳的三句废话全中：既有好处也有坏处 + 扬长避短 + 让我们携手共创美好未来（口号感叹句）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: In conclusion, while automated decision systems inevitably introduce transitional labor friction and verification challenges, integrating them into industrial and academic workflows yields substantial long-term productivity gains. By pairing algorithmic deployment with transparent audit trails and targeted workforce retraining, institutions can capture efficiency breakthroughs without eroding human analytical oversight. Ultimately, the value of intelligent automation rests not on replacing human judgment, but on elevating the precision of the evidence upon which human judgment acts.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 流程图/算法流水线与闭环工序衔接段（Process & Closed-Loop Lifecycle）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 流程图（Process Diagram）/ 论文系统工程 Pipeline 描述段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [流程总括与起止界定 Lifecycle Overview]：The diagram illustrates the closed-loop pipeline for [Process Name], comprising [N] main stages from initial [Input Stage] to continuous [Feedback/Output Stage].
S2 [前段采集与预处理 Initial Ingestion & Filtering]：The process begins when raw [Material/Data] is collected via [Source] and passed through [Filter/Chamber] to remove [Impurities/Outliers].
S3 [中段并行分流 Parallel Branching]：Once purified, the stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: [Fraction A] undergoes [Process A], whereas [Fraction B] is routed to [Process B].

S4 [末端合成与闭环回流 Synthesis & Closed-Loop Recycling]：The resulting outputs are subsequently merged in [Unit C], with residual by-products / high-error trajectories recycled back into the initial buffer for iterative refinement.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Pipeline Overview -> Ingestion & Filtering -> Parallel Bifurcation -> Terminal Merger & Feedback Loop. 绑定逻辑规则：L003, L005.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: First, raw data is collected. Then it is cleaned. Then it goes into two branches. Branch 1 does A, and Branch 2 does B. Then they are combined. Finally, bad samples go back to the beginning.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 连续四个 Then，词汇贫乏（cleaned, goes into, does A, bad samples go back）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The diagram illustrates the closed-loop data curation pipeline for embodied robot learning, spanning four primary stages from teleoperated collection to failure-driven retraining. The cycle begins when raw multimodal demonstrations are recorded via VR teleoperation and filtered to discard kinematic singularities and dropped frames. Once validated, the trajectory stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: visual frames undergo background augmentation, while proprioceptive states are normalized into local gripper coordinates. These processed streams are subsequently synchronized to train the visuomotor policy, whose real-world rollout failures are logged and fed back into the teleoperation buffer to close the active-learning loop.

focal_logic_rules.category: Logical Fallacy Prevention (逻辑谬误防范)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 诊断与修复逻辑跳跃（Bridging Logical Leaps / Missing Premises）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Diagnosing and Bridging Missing Logical Premises
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 作者脑子里清楚 A -> B -> C，但写出来只写了 A，紧接着就 wrote Therefore, C。修改时必须站在审稿人/读者视角，把隐含的中间桥接前提 B（Missing Premise）显式补写出来。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Premise A: [Observation]. -> Missing Bridge B: [Because A implies Property B under Condition K], -> Conclusion C: [Therefore, Design/Policy C is necessary].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 滥用 Therefore / Thus / Hence 强行连接两句根本没有直接推出关系的话。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Industrial time series contain missing values at irregular intervals. Therefore, we use a continuous-time neural ODE encoder.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Industrial sensor streams frequently suffer from irregular missing timestamps due to packet loss. Because standard discrete-step RNNs assume uniform sampling intervals and distort time-delta dynamics when inputs are missing, we model latent state evolution between arbitrary observation times using a continuous-time neural ODE.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 补全了关键中间前提：“离散步长 RNN 默认等间隔采样，在缺失值下会扭曲时间间隔动力学”，从而让引入连续时间神经 ODE 变得顺理成章。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 图尔敏五步微论证模型（Toulmin Micro-Argumentation）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 任何一个独立成段的学术或议论主张，都必须具备完整的五要素：① 主张（Claim）、② 机理解释（Mechanism/Reason）、③ 实证数据或具象案例（Evidence）、④ 逻辑桥梁（Warrant：为什么该证据能证明该主张）、⑤ 边界限定（Qualification/Hedging）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [S1: Claim] -> [S2: Underlying Mechanism] -> [S3: Concrete Metric/Instance] -> [S4: Warrant/Implication] -> [S5: Boundary/Scope Qualification].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 只有 Claim + 换句话重复一遍 Claim + 空洞夸张形容词，中间既无传导机制也无具象证据。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Patch-level tokenization is much better than point-wise tokenization. It captures local information very well and improves time series forecasting significantly in all cases.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Patch-level tokenization outperforms point-wise representations in long-horizon time series forecasting [Claim]. Whereas single time steps lack semantic context and amplify high-frequency noise, contiguous sub-series patches preserve local slope and periodicity [Mechanism]. On the ETTm2 benchmark, grouping 16 consecutive steps reduces 720-step MSE by 18.7% compared with point-wise attention [Evidence]. This gain confirms that local structural aggregation mitigates attention dispersion over long lookback windows [Warrant], although excessively large patches may blur abrupt transient anomalies [Qualification].
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 五句话各司其职：立论 -> 对比机理 -> ETTm2 实证数据 -> 理论印证 -> 诚实指出过大 Patch 的边界局限，无懈可击。

focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写双图题（如一张图是算力投入/研发经费变化，另一张图是模型误差/碳排放强度变化）的综合关联段，阐明两张图之间的内在协同或背离关系。

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L028 诊断与修复逻辑跳跃（Bridging Logical Leaps / Missing Premises））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 极其简陋，未能刻画“初期强相关 -> 超过阈值后边际收益递减 -> 特例分析”的层次感。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L018 口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 包含 SoP 两大禁忌：① 童年情怀套话（Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by...）；② 盲目追热点（because it is a very hot topic），没讲清你过去的时序/生成建模背景赋予了你做具身智能什么独特优势。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: My research focuses on learning reliable representations and generative trajectories from non-stationary sequential data. While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions. Bridging my background in non-stationary time-series modeling and fast flow-matching samplers, my future research aims to build adaptive visuomotor world models that allow embodied robots to generalize across unfamiliar contact regimes in real time.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: We evaluate DyTS-Net across eight long-horizon forecasting benchmarks and a real-world wind-turbine telemetry system spanning 1,400 sensors. Across all prediction horizons up to 720 steps, DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 12.8% over PatchTST and 17.4% over iTransformer, with the largest gains emerging during sudden weather-front transitions. Furthermore, our architecture requires 45% fewer FLOPs than full channel-mixing Transformers and transfers zero-shot to newly deployed turbine units without fine-tuning.
